hook: Khelo India Youth Games come to Telangana: *6,050+* athletes, 12 days
hook_b: Khelo India Youth Games come to Telangana: *6,050+* athletes, 12 days
tldr: Telangana hosts the Khelo India Youth Games from December 11 to 22, with 27 sports across six cities (Telangana Today).

beats.what: The Khelo India Youth Games run December 11–22 in Telangana, with 27 competitive sports and sailing as a demonstration event.
beats.why: It's a 12-day national youth sports meet, spread over six cities in the state.
beats.care: A national multi-sport event is coming to Telangana next month. Venues and ticket details were not in the report.

cards.title: 🆕 What's new
cards.body: More than 6,050 athletes are expected. The report says six cities will host events; the full venue list and spectator details are not out yet.

cards.q: Khelo India in Telangana: will you go watch?
Which sport is a demonstration event at these Games?
cards.why: Sailing joins the 27 competitive sports as a demo event.

learn.t: Khelo India Youth Games = India's national multi-sport meet for young athletes, run under the Khelo India scheme.

watch: Venue list, schedule by sport and spectator entry details.
